prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web storefront direction comp for SKYMART
Primary request: Design the actual edge-to-edge first viewport and beginning of the next section for a Thai multi-vendor marketplace called SKYMART. Visual world: ‘Product Theatre’ — museum design shop meets precision product launch. Every useful object receives a deliberate stage while marketplace breadth appears as a quiet curated index.
Surface structure: a slim functional navigation with SKYMART wordmark, Thai search, categories, account and cart; one consumer product is demonstrated at nearly life scale on a white cyclorama that occupies most of the viewport, while a compact semantic buying rail is physically integrated into the stage and shows Thai product name, THB price, rating, delivery, variant selection, quantity and add-to-cart; a narrow vertical catalog index reveals other categories and sellers; the beginning of the next section enters like an exhibition inventory rather than an equal card grid.
Mode: persuade. The visitor must instantly understand this is a marketplace and can add the staged product to cart from the first viewport.
Content: synthetic consumer products, lead with a sculptural compact espresso machine; supporting glimpses of wireless headphones, desk lamp and carry-on luggage. Exact brand text: ‘SKYMART’. Exact primary CTA: ‘เพิ่มลงตะกร้า’. Exact search prompt: ‘ค้นหาสินค้าที่ใช่’.
Style/medium: production-grade premium ecommerce interface, realistic product photography integrated with semantic web controls, not a poster, not a device mockup, not a browser screenshot.
Color palette: white #FAFAF8, near-black #111214, soft neutral #E7E8E5, precise blue #1E63E9, tiny acid-lime #C4FF3D only for one live availability cue.
Materials/textures: white cyclorama, anodized aluminum, optical glass.
Composition/framing: landscape desktop page at 1440×1000 proportions, edge to edge, no browser chrome. One dominant product theatre gesture; calm supporting areas; real 16px body scale.
Constraints: readable Thai UI; no invented claims, discounts, awards, statistics or testimonials; no Apple or Shopee logos, layouts, assets, or trade dress; no generic split hero, no centered headline over cards, no gradients, no glassmorphism, no excessive rounded cards, no watermark.
